# Book of Giants Fragment 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA (Arbiter) | **Source:** 4Q530 col. vi (Cave 4) | **Condition:** moderately well preserved; epistolary format

---

**6:1** [...] Copy of the second tablet of the letter [...]

**6:2** [...] by the hand of Enoch, the scribe of interpretation [...]

**6:3** [...] to all who dwell upon the earth [...]

**6:4** [...] and to the Watchers [...] let it be known to you [...]

**6:5** [...] that your petition shall not be granted to you [...]

**6:6** [...] To the Watchers and the giants: Let it be known to you that your deeds [...]

**6:7** [...] and your deeds and those of your wives [...]

**6:8** [...] have cried out against you [...]

**6:9** [...] your requests will not be granted to you [...]

**6:10** [...] from this day to eternity [...]

**6:11** [...] and your wives [...] and your children [...] through your fornication on the earth [...]

**6:12** [...] destruction and bondage have come upon you [...]

**6:13** [...] the land will not be left to you [...]

**6:14** [...] for you have loved corruption [...]

**6:15** [...] and the violence and the blood of the righteous [...]

**6:16** [...] the sentence of judgment will come upon you [...]

**6:17** [...] and the judgment of the great flood [...]

**6:18** [...] will come upon you and upon your offspring [...]

**6:19** [...] and you shall be bound in the depths of the earth [...]

**6:20** [...] until the judgment of eternity [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Fragment 6 (Enoch's Response to the Giants). Source: 4Q530 col. vi. The SOPHIA consensus translation adjudicates between EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic) renderings. Priority is given to accuracy, preserving established biblical idiom, and maintaining the theological register of the Enochic literature. All disagreements are logged separately. Square brackets indicate genuine manuscript lacunae.*
